messages:
Nisha: noticed spike in 'projectless' on console for org-acme around 10:40. billing looks off.
Raj: any request id or region?
Olga: sample req id 2a4b9c, from eu-central. headers show `x-origin-project: billing` earlier but auth-service shows no project claim.
Ben: ops-bot pulled trace 2a4b9c 1750599: token-introspect returned 502 at the time.
ops-bot: token-introspect 502 hits = 0.6% in last 5m.
Nisha: sounds like introspect errors -> router fallback to org-only (projectless). Proposal: short-term add telemetry tag `attribution_reason:introspect_error` so dashboards can filter.
Raj: mid-term: router should set `soft_attribution=true` when header present but introspect fails; console should surface soft vs authoritative.
Olga: UX note: tooltip explaining "soft-attributed = header seen, not verified". product asked for a "pin this attribution" CTA for customers.
Ben: infra: add alert when introspect 5xx rate > 0.2% over 5m and a runbook link.
Nisha: owners: telemetry (Raj), console UX (Olga), router change (Ben). I'll file RFC and chart.
Raj: filing telemetry ticket ENG-1501.
Olga: drafting console PR and hover copy.
Ben: adding alert and runbook.
Nisha: thanks team :thumbsup: keeping this open until telemetry and alert exist.
